decision_rules.GOOD_ENOUGH: PASS on the full matrix; no reproducible evidence that deferring maintenance materially lowers peak memory or contention
decision_rules.NO_GO: decision requires native concurrent optimize, scheduler changes, or policy/threshold changes
decision_rules.TEN_CANDIDATE: a reproducible cell fails an envelope and a compliant deferred-finalize experiment reduces peak total PSS or cgroup peak by at least 20 percent without correctness or retrieval regression

envelope_status: frozen-for-v1; any change requires a new protocol id and preregistration commit

fixture.delete_set: deterministic 10 percent of files, fixed before run
fixture.layout: src/chunk_{chunk}/file_{ordinal}.rs plus one query term per file
fixture.model: local/potion-code-16m-v2; no download during measured phase
fixture.query_set: deterministic 100 exact terms spanning inserted, modified, and stable files
fixture.temperature: one warm index per workspace before measured runs; warmup excluded

host_preflight.cpu_affinity: reserve and record 8 logical CPUs for daemon/CLI; do not change affinity mid-run
host_preflight.foreign_zg_daemons: must be absent or isolated by HOME/ZVEC_GREP_HOME; record pgrep -af zg
host_preflight.host: single Linux host; record kernel, CPU model, logical CPUs, NUMA, memory total
host_preflight.on_failure: do not run; report FAILED_PREFLIGHT with the exact missing capability or host condition
required_capabilities: cgroup v2 with memory, cpu, io, pids controllers
cgroup memory.current, memory.peak, memory.swap.current/peak, memory.pressure, io.pressure, cpu.pressure
delegated systemd user scope with MemoryAccounting=yes and KillMode=control-group
model cache present; no model download allowed

matrix.order: randomized blocks with seed 20261101; counterbalance dirty/clean and insert/delete order
matrix.restart_definition: stop daemon, wait for exit, start daemon, wait ready, run one query and one reopen check

timing.engine_execution: job started to terminal observation; daemon log timestamps may be required
timing.phase_timing: recorded by the harness at phase boundaries
timing.scheduler_wait: job.waited_millis when queued; derive from job observation timestamps when running

observability_gaps: JobView exposes waited_millis but not engine start/finish timestamps or engine CPU; scheduler wait versus engine execution is not fully separable without daemon logs.
The daemon is one process hosting multiple workspace engines; per-workspace memory is not attributable from cgroup/process totals without new instrumentation.
No phase-scoped cgroup peak; memory.peak is per run, not per native optimize/finalize phase.
No native optimize internal phase boundary or per-collection memory attribution.
Queue polling is observational and can perturb timing; it is sampled at 500 ms and not used as a gate.
No dedicated native concurrent-optimize telemetry is allowed; none is required for this scope.

pass_fail.FAIL: any correctness guard fails, any forbidden change is required, or an envelope is exceeded
pass_fail.INCONCLUSIVE: telemetry is incomplete, cgroup peak cannot be reset, or host interference prevents attribution; do not silently downgrade to PASS
pass_fail.PASS: all correctness guards pass and every primary/contention envelope holds for every measured cell and repetition

provenance.note: Docs-only commits after 2478776 do not change the measured binary, but the exact binary hash must still be recorded.

correctness.delete_visibility: deleted files absent from FTS and vector results
correctness.recovery: reopen returns the same visible result sets
correctness.retrieval_parity: exact result-set match for all fixture queries
correctness.single_writer_per_root: no overlap in writer ownership; zero violations

reuse.cgroup_reference: research/m4-native/tools/m4_containment_runner.py: required cgroup telemetry, memory/swap/PSI/io readers, process smaps aggregation
reuse.contracts: benchmarks/harness-v2/contracts for receipt/policy provenance; no new policy or threshold is introduced
reuse.host: benchmarks/harness-v2/host/primitives.py: host_snapshot, process_resource_sample, cgroup_path_from_unit, cgroup_populated, service_properties, make_receipt_dir
reuse.measurement: benchmarks/harness-v2/measurement/primitives.py: UTC/boottime clocks, bounded SHA-256, strict JSON, receipt writing
